decision: RULE 2 WAIVER - RE-CONFIRMED AT MEASURED SCALE

rule_being_waived.text: 'pay nothing. Absolutely nothing. No paid tier, no metered API, and no vendor's free credit tier either.'
rule_being_waived.reason_for_the_rule_as_stated: A vendor product is a dependency on someone else's pricing, quota, ToS and schema, all of which drift.

scope_of_waiver.authorised_for: Deepgram ONLY - the metered speech-to-text call.
explicitly_not_waived: Any other paid tier or metered service
The corpus-acquisition route, which remains vendor-free

reconfirmed_waiver.basis: MEASURED corpus duration, not an extrapolation
reconfirmed_waiver.rate_provenance: audio-and-stt.md, CUT30 era. NOT re-derived or negotiated for this corpus.
reconfirmed_waiver.actual_spend: NOT YET OBSERVED - no request has been made. Actual and forecast must stay separate in every report.

scale_correction.magnitude_change: The 2026-10-13 waiver was ~97x smaller than the measured figure. Re-confirming at the true scale is the entire point of recording the waiver at all.

conditions_attached: Budget is spent against the MEASURED duration, never a planning estimate.
Forecast and actual spend are recorded separately, always. audio-and-stt.md: the balance file on the CUT30 run was 0 bytes, so 'actual spend' was NOT IN SOURCE there.

Receipts are written PER UNIT as the run proceeds, never batched at the end. A crash between the last response and the batch summary discards every receipt earned and the next run re-bills the corpus.
Spend is monitored against the USD 136.31 forecast and work STOPS if the forecast is exceeded. The forecast is a ceiling, not a target.
Quota and payment responses (402/429/credit) are treated as a PAUSE of this stage only, never a halt of the build.
on_receipts_and_resume: Key every receipt on the stable call identity, never on a MEGA URL or any expiring token.
Do not persist a MEGA direct-download link. Resolve fresh immediately before each call.

integrity.note: No course audio has been sent to any vendor. This record authorises future spend; it does not report spend.
